findings.title: Swift Task cancellation after VERIFIED was not checked at the MainActor commit boundary
findings.sourceTrace: After the last client Task.checkCancellation and actor hop, adoptWebsite calls verified.commit; v1 checked only the ticket. The browser task-cancellation handler had already ended. Task.cancel alone therefore did not cancel the active ticket before retirement/installation.
findings.reproducer: Pause openWebsiteSignIn with the existing beforeCommit gate after VERIFIED; cancel that Swift Task without explicit UI/ticket cancellation; release the gate. v1 source reaches previousLifetime.retire/install. This source trace was not executed locally.
findings.correction: Three Task.checkCancellation guards before ticket commit and before/after the bounded journal read; one paused-VERIFIED model regression added. The other 17 frozen paths are unchanged.
